metadata.attribution: Five test excerpts: BANKING77, PolyAI, CC BY 4.0, https://github.com/PolyAI-LDN/task-specific-datasets
metadata.scope: Post-hoc test audit only. No training, model selection, calibration refit or threshold retuning.

local_cases.text: How do I avoid getting charged a fee on my card?
How do I make sure I don't run out of money on my card while traveling?
Can I verify a top-up and what card is used?

global.interpretation: Mean absolute original-predicted-class score change by word occurrence. Two messages per true class; not natural production frequencies. Signed means and occurrence counts retained.

cost.measurement_scope: Wall-clock explanations with batched variants and a warm shared model. Model load, full-test predictions and rendering are separate.
